reason: A persistent floating power-button plugin for DeepSeek Harness that provides local stop and restart controls, health status, and process relaunch behavior.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供固定在窗口右下角的悬浮电源按钮，用于查看状态并一键停止或重启本地进程。
summaries.en: Adds a floating power button to DeepSeek Harness for viewing status and stopping or restarting the local process.

capabilities: Adds a floating user-interface button for controlling DeepSeek Harness
Stops or restarts the local DeepSeek Harness process through HTTP endpoints
Spawns a detached helper process to relaunch DeepSeek Harness with its original arguments and environment
Installs persistently as a user-level profile plugin
